extracted.intended_audience: education policymakers, vocational/technical educators, researchers, and institutions interested in Ford Foundation grants in vocational education (historical)
extracted.subtask_description: Summarizes the Ford Foundation's grantmaking priorities and representative pilot programs in vocational and technical education (secondary and post-secondary), listing categories of grants and example program objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vocational education as an integral part of education
rubrics_metrics.description: The Ford Foundation views vocational education as an integral part of education, particularly at all levels of secondary and post-secondary education, and believes improvement of vocational and technical education is the responsibility of all educators, academic and general as well as vocational.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should treat vocational/technical subjects as central to education policy and practice, promote integration across academic and vocational educators, and target multiple educational levels rather than treating vocational education as separate or peripheral.

rubrics_metrics.name: Curriculum improvement (category)
rubrics_metrics.description: Nine grants in curriculum improvement — pilot programs and experiments focused on improving vocational/technical curricula.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funded projects in this category include development of comprehensive secondary school models, curriculum centers for continuing curriculum research, and efforts to update engineering and technological education curricula; proposals should demonstrate concrete curriculum development or improvement activities and potential for replication or research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research, development, and information (category)
rubrics_metrics.description: Four grants in research, development, and information supporting study and dissemination related to vocational education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should contribute to R&D, produce generalizable knowledge or resources, and include mechanisms for information sharing and adoption across institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vocational-technical teacher training (category)
rubrics_metrics.description: Four grants in vocational-technical teacher training aimed at preparing instructors for vocational and technical programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preferred projects include formal teacher preparation programs (e.g., multi-year degree programs), in-service training for vocational instructors, and initiatives that link academic and technical training for teachers serving post-secondary and two-year institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cooperative work-study education (category)
rubrics_metrics.description: Thirteen grants in cooperative work-study education focusing on schemes that combine classroom instruction with work experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should demonstrate partnerships with employers, structured work-study curricula, and goals such as improving student engagement, employability, and transitions between school and work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dropout-motivation programs (representative objective)
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs designed to determine which approach in vocational education works best in motivating recent dropouts to finish high school.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funded initiatives should include experimental or pilot designs to test approaches for re-engaging dropouts, with measurable outcomes on school completion and clear evaluation plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive secondary school models integrating vocational and academic electives
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs to develop truly comprehensive secondary schools that offer vocational and technical subjects as electives in the same way as academic subjects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should aim to integrate vocational and academic curricula within the same school structures, enabling parity between vocational and academic elective offerings and documenting effects on student choice and achievement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Curriculum center for continuing research (representative objective)
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishment of a curriculum center to concentrate on continuing research designed to improve and update engineering technological education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funded centers should provide ongoing curriculum development, periodic updating of technical subjects, dissemination of findings, and serve as hubs for research-informed curricular change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Four-year teacher preparation programs for two-year institutions (representative objective)
rubrics_metrics.description: A 4-year program designed to prepare academic and technical teachers for 2-year programs at junior colleges, community colleges, technical institutes, and similar institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should describe structured degree programs that prepare instructors specifically for the instructional, curricular, and institutional contexts of two-year post-secondary vocational/technical education.
